I ate the bare minimum of calories in my dorm room and I made sure it was HEALTHY. I lived off of fruits and veggies and poultry. I avoided carbs. I lost like thirty, maybe forty pounds in a semester. You could use my body as before and after pictures but my brain wasn’t done
